(Japanese: '''「ポケットモンスター　ＸＹ」スタート直前ＳＰ　～ロード　to　カロス～''' ''Pocket Monsters XY Pre-Start Special: Road to Kalos'') is an [[List of animated series specials|animated series special]] that previews the beginning of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', while also [[clip show|showing]] some past events. It aired in Japan on October 10, 2013, a week before the [[XY001|premiere]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
{{Ash}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} are on a plane heading to [[Kalos]].<!--Pokémon games, flashbacks of Ash from OS to BW, plane (day, Ash talks to Pikachu about Kalos), titlecard, plane (evening, Ash is sleeping and Pikachu is looking outside), EP001 flashback, plane (night, 6 hours to Kalos, Ash and Pikachu are sleeping), XY series preview, flashbacks of Ash and some of his friends from OS to BW, plane (night, Ash and Pikachu are sleeping), XY series preview (Clemont, Bonnie, Professor Sycamore, Serena, Team Rocket), plane (night, Ash and Pikachu are sleeping), XY series preview, EP002 flashback, EP003 flashback, plane (dawn, 2 hours to Kalos, Ash is sleeping and Pikachu wakes up), XY series preview (Mega Evolution), V (Volt) preview, plane (morning, Pikachu wakes Ash up), XY001 and XY002 preview-->
